purpose: extend ODSP from projection-loss diagnosis to state-resolved ecological prediction and independent predictive validation
core_prediction_target: P(A|B) or P(A|X) for declared ecological state A

interpretation.B: declared discrete base/reference state, such as spatial cell, site or species-context
interpretation.X: optional continuous or mixed covariate vector used by an upstream probabilistic classifier
interpretation.A: one or more added ecological states, such as layer, height, depth, time bin, phenophase, behaviour or microhabitat
interpretation.prediction_unit: a full probability distribution over A, not a single suitability scalar

algorithm_position.odsp_role: model-agnostic state-resolved prediction and evaluation framework
external_learners_supported: arbitrary externally produced normalized state-probability fields
other_learners_supported_in_principle: MaxEnt-like or other ecological prediction models producing state probabilities
algorithm_position.external_model_interface: conditional probability field plus an explicitly fitted marginal comparator

minimum_inputs: non-negative training support, event-level state records, or covariate rows with state labels
declared base axes B for discrete support models or covariates X for continuous prediction
recommended_inputs_for_generalization: prospectively independent held-out individuals, sites, years, regions or instruments
explicit observation semantics for every state axis
native_outputs_per_prediction: seen-versus-backoff status for the discrete native model

primary.mean_log_score: proper probabilistic score of state prediction on independent support
primary.mean_log_score_gain: mean log-score improvement over fitted marginal P(A)

secondary.brier_improvement: marginal Brier minus state-resolved Brier; positive is better
secondary.top1_accuracy: mass fraction assigned to the most probable predicted state
secondary.top1_improvement: state-resolved top-1 accuracy minus marginal top-1 accuracy
secondary.mean_assigned_probability: mean probability assigned to the realized held-out state
secondary.seen_base_mass_fraction: for discrete base models, fraction of held-out mass in base states observed during training

validated_behavior: stable organization produces consistently positive independent gain
shifted organization produces consistently negative independent gain
unorganized support converges toward zero gain
state-probability RMSE decreases with sample size

groupwise_rule.generalizing: all independent-group log-score gains are strictly positive beyond tolerance
groupwise_rule.mixed: gain signs conflict across independent groups

native_unseen_base_options: uniform over structurally available added states
scientific_boundaries: state-resolved prediction does not infer the biological meaning of axes
the discrete native learner does not smoothly extrapolate across continuous environmental gradients
continuous extrapolation is supplied by an explicit covariate learner and must be independently validated
observation bias, detectability and causal identification are not removed automatically
a predicted state distribution is not automatically a fundamental niche
existing closed Tawaki, bat and Serengeti N2 endpoints are not reopened by this extension
development_next: state-resolved map and raster export for GIS
R package front end with fit, predict, score, summary and plot methods
empirical demonstration using an independent public dataset selected prospectively for state prediction rather than reusing closed N2 endpoints
